positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked with the Experience Centers team to integrated a gaze tracking system into a GigaPixel image viewer for hands free navigation.
Created a framework for multi computer animation synchronization.

positions.title: EE-355 Mentor
positions.description: Held office hours to help Electrical Engineering students learning C++ and graded their homework.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Working with the G+ photos team to bring advanced photo manipulation tools to web and mobile platforms while maintaining a homogeneous user experience.

positions.title: Academic Part Time Software Engineer (Processing Algorithms and Calibration)
positions.description: Created server side processes that mimic existing desktop applications' functionality for data exploration. Conduct tradeoff studies for client side performance depending on varying degrees of server side processing.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created mobile (iOS) applications for scientific data retrieval and visualization as well server-side back-end to support specific data sources.

positions.title: Mentor (tutor)
positions.description: Tutored local public high school students in the subjects of Sophomore/Junior English, AP Biology, AP Chemistry, AP Physics, and AP Calculus (AB).

projects.title: Avocado - The Web Genome Project (Alpha Build)
projects.description:
- Avocado is a predictive Google Chrome extension, which intelligently recommends relevant websites based on past browsing history
- The web portal allows you to perform a visual search by keyword, then presents similar websites that other users have visited, based on keyword
- Began development at HackTech, January 2014

projects.title: USC WVT Rusch Engineering Honors Colloquium Moderator
projects.description: I aided in selecting and organizing speakers for the USC WVT Rusch Engineering Honors Colloquium. I also introduced the speakers to the class each Friday before their talk.

patents.title: Estimating a metabolic rate of a user wearing a wearable computing device
patents.description: A method for estimating a metabolic rate of a user includes obtaining pulse oximetry data for the user for a period of time.

patents.title: Multi channel voice activity detection
patents.description: Advanced techniques for turn and speaker detection using multi-channel audio from a microphone array.
